doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27

title: Blanche's son Alfred and his illness; Abbie's fear of diabetes
summary: Raymond Burke is remembered at Alfred's wake, and Blanche tells of Alfred's sickly life, diabetes, stroke and death, and Abbie Brunies's fear of the disease.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
